title: Burnsville Lake Mowing and Maintenance Services 2027-2031
description: The Huntington District Corps of Engineers intends to procure an Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Contract for Mowing and Maintenance Services for Burnsville Lake, Burnsville, WV. The Performance Period will be a base period of one (1) year and four (4) option periods of one (1) year each. The base period for this contract will be from 01 January 2027 through 31 December 2027. The contract will be a Firm Fixed Price, Commercial Service type contract with a ceiling amount of $1,100,000.00 over the entire contract period. The Government will award a contract resulting from this solicitation to the responsible offeror whose offer conforming to the solicitation will be most advantageous to the Government, price and other factors considered. Evaluation Factor A (Past Performance), Factor B (Management and Controls), Factor C (Equipment/Personnel), and Factor D (Cost/Price) are listed in descending order of importance. The best value tradeoff process will be used in this acquisition with award made (as a whole) to the offeror whose quote conforms to the solicitation and has been evaluated as most advantageous to the Government with appropriate consideration given to the evaluation factors. Offerors will be cautioned that the award may not necessarily be made to the lowest price offered. All non-priced factors, when combined, are more important than price. In accordance with 52.219-14, Limitations on Subcontracting (DEVIATION), by submission of an offer and execution of a contract, the Contractor agrees to comply with the limitations on subcontracting. To demonstrate compliance, the contractor shall submit the Post-Award Contractors Limitations on Subcontracting Certification to the Contracting Officer or Contracting Officers Representative (COR) if one has been appointed. For contracts with a period of performance lasting less than 12 months, the contractor shall submit the Certification at the end of the performance period. For contracts with a period of performance lasting more than 12 months, the contractor shall submit the Certification at the one-year anniversary of contract award and then annually thereafter until the end of the performance period. For contracts with options years, the contractor shall submit the Certification at the end of the base year and then at the end of each subsequent option year. Solicitation documents will be available on or about 09 November 2026, online at https://www.piee.eb.mil. To be eligible for contract award, an Offeror must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM). Register via the SAM website at https://www.sam.gov. Questions may be submitted to Tatum Bock at tatum.a.bock@usace.army.mil . A NAICS Code of 561730 has been established for this solicitation. The size standard is $9,500,000 in average annual receipts. This procurement is 100% Small Business set-aside.

Notice of VISN-Based Solicitation Structure Since release of the prior draft solicitation, the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) has refined the acquisition strategy for Real Estate Acquisition Support Services to align with the Veterans Health Administration�s (VHA) evolving regional operating model. This revised approach supports VA�s broader Restructure for Impact and Sustainability Effort (RISE), an organizational transformation directed by Executive Order 14210. RISE is intended to streamline VHA structures and processes, strengthen regional implementation and accountability, and support more consistent, coordinated, and responsive services for Veterans. Accordingly, VA has transitioned from a single nationwide contractor-pool approach to a multiple-award IDIQ structure organized by Veterans Integrated Service Network (VISN) Coverage Area. Benefits of the VISN-based approach include: Allowing qualified SDVOSB offerors to compete for one or more VISN Coverage Areas rather than requiring a nationwide proposal; Enabling offerors to focus proposals on geographic areas where they can demonstrate staffing, local-market resources, capacity, and lawful authority to operate; Supporting focused competition and VISN-specific commission pricing; Improving alignment between broker support, VA regional lease-acquisition operations, and local-market requirements; Strengthening accountability for contractor capacity, performance, quality control, and continuity of services within each VISN Coverage Area; and Supporting VA�s broader effort to simplify operations, improve consistency, and enable more effective implementation at the regional and local levels. VA considered feedback received during the draft-solicitation/RFI phase. However, because the solicitation has been materially revised since the draft-solicitation/RFI phase, VA is not posting the historical draft-stage questions and Government responses. Those historical responses may not reflect the requirements, proposal instructions, evaluation approach, or procedures in the final solicitation. The final solicitation, its attachments, and any written amendments issued by the Contracting Officer are the only authoritative sources for solicitation requirements. Offerors shall submit questions concerning the final solicitation in accordance with the solicitation�s instructions.

title: ISBEE Solicitation: 24/7 Telebehavioral Health Emergency Department Support Services � Great Plains Area.
description: ISBEE Set-Aside � 24/7 Telebehavioral Health Emergency Department Support Services Solicitation No. 75H70627R00006 This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial services prepared in accordance with FAR Part 12, as supplemented by the attached solicitation documents. This announcement and its attachments constitute the solicitation. Proposals are requested, and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation No. 75H70627R00006 is issued as a Request for Proposals (RFP) for 24/7 Telebehavioral Health Emergency Department Support Services. The Great Plains Area Indian Health Service (IHS) seeks a contractor to provide non-personal, synchronous audio-video telebehavioral health services 24 hours per day, seven days per week, including weekends and federal holidays. Initial supported Emergency Departments are Pine Ridge, Rosebud, and Eagle Butte in South Dakota, and Fort Yates and Belcourt in North Dakota. Services include crisis behavioral health assessment, suicide-risk evaluation, safety planning, crisis intervention, placement assistance, interpreter-access coordination, and medication-stabilization consultation by qualified prescribing providers when clinically indicated. The contractor shall furnish qualified licensed personnel, staffing management, backup and surge coverage, credentialing support, and other contractor-furnished resources necessary to perform the Performance Work Statement (PWS) and applicable task orders. This acquisition is set aside exclusively for Indian Small Business Economic Enterprises (ISBEEs). The assigned NAICS code is 621112, Offices of Physicians, Mental Health Specialists, with a small business size standard of $13.5 million. Offerors shall satisfy the eligibility and representation requirements in the solicitation and submit the completed IHS Indian Economic Enterprise Representation form with their proposals. The anticipated award is a firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity (IDIQ) contract with one 12-month base ordering period and four 12-month option ordering periods. The anticipated start date for services is August 1, 2027. The anticipated base period is August 1, 2027, through July 31, 2028, with an ordering period extending through July 31, 2032, if all options are exercised. Services will be authorized and funded through written task orders identifying covered facilities, performance periods, and applicable requirements. The contract minimum guarantee is $25,000, and the maximum ordering ceiling is $2,600,000. The ceiling does not represent guaranteed expenditures or orders beyond the contract minimum. Section F of the attached solicitation identifies the CLINs, service descriptions, quantities, units of measure, and performance periods. Offerors shall complete that price schedule with firm-fixed monthly pricing by facility for the base period and each option period. The total evaluated price will include the base period and all four option periods. Award will be made to the responsible offeror whose proposal conforms to the solicitation and represents the best value to the Government. Evaluation factors are Technical Capability, Past Performance, Management Approach, and Price. When combined, the non-price factors are significantly more important than price. The Government intends to award without discussions but reserves the right to conduct discussions as provided in the solicitation. Questions must be received no later than 12:00 p.m. (noon) Central Standard Time (CST) on November 18, 2026. Proposals must be received no later than 12:00 p.m. (noon) CST on December 2, 2026. Submit questions and proposals electronically to David.Jones@ihs.gov, referencing Solicitation No. 75H70627R00006 in the email subject line. Offerors must have a valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) and active SAM.gov registration as required by the solicitation. Applicable solicitation provisions and contract clauses are identified in the attached provision/clause schedule. Incorporated FAR provisions and clauses are accessible at https://www.acquisition.gov. Review the complete attached solicitation package, including the PWS, price schedule, submission instructions, evaluation criteria, applicable FAR/HHSAR provisions and clauses, and any amendments before submitting a proposal.

title: Z2DA--FY27 EHRM | 657-21-702JC EHRM Training And Administrative Space Construction - St Louis John Cochran
description: INTRODUCTION The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), Program Contracting Activity Central (PCAC) anticipates soliciting bids and subsequently awarding a single firm-fixed-price contract for the design-bid-build EHRM Training and Administrative Space Construction project at the St. Louis VA Health Care System (VAHCS) John Cochran campus located at 915 North Grand BLVD, St. Louis, MO 63106. PROJECT DESCRIPTION The VA Saint Louis Health Care System John Cochran Division requires a construction contractor to perform upgrades in support of the Electronic Health Record Modernization (EHRM) program. The construction area is located on the first floor of Building 2 and includes both training and administrative spaces. This project includes the execution of Phases 2, 3, and 4 of the associated design plans. Phase 2 addresses the North Training Rooms (Rooms 139, 140, 141, 142), totaling approximately 2,000 square feet. Work includes upgraded power and data infrastructure and new flooring and wall finishes. Phase 3 addresses the South Training Rooms (Rooms 126, 127, 128), totaling approximately 1,800 square feet. Work includes upgraded power and data infrastructure and new flooring and wall finishes. Additionally, Phase 3 includes the renovation of a 130-square-foot breakroom, with new floor and wall finishes, casework, a new sink, and a cold-water tie-in for an ice machine. Phase 4 addresses multiple areas: renovation of an approximately 1,400-square-foot corridor with new floor and wall finishes; upgrades to two offices (approximately 150 square feet each) with upgraded power and data infrastructure and new flooring and wall finishes; and upgrades to an existing data closet, including new floor and wall finishes, installation of an additional server rack with associated equipment, and replacement of the existing mini-split HVAC unit. Note: Phase 1 is excluded from this scope, as it was completed under a separate contract. Note: All power and data drops originally indicated as floor-mounted shall now be wall-mounted, as shown on revised drawings EP101 and TN101. Installation must match these updated sheet details; no floor-mounted outlets are permitted. ADMINISTRATIVE The solicitation will be issued as an Invitation for Bids (IFB) conducted in accordance with FAR part 14 and will be evaluated in accordance with the procedures listed in the solicitation. The solicitation will be issued as a total Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) set-aside. Offers received from other than SDVOSB concerns will not be considered. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 236220 with a size standard of $45.0 million. The solicitation will be issued in early to mid-October 2026. The period of performance is approximately 150 calendar days from the issuance of the notice to proceed. In accordance with VAAR 836.204, the magnitude of construction is between $250,000 and $500,000. This notice is not a request for competitive offers. All questions must be submitted in writing to the issuing office via email to Amanda.Webster@va.gov. Telephone calls will not be accepted.

title: Commercial Gear Backup Power (CGBP) and Control System Improvements at Fish Barrier
description: I. PURPOSE AND DISCLAIMER**********************The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Chicago District, is issuing this sources sought synopsis as a means of conducting market research to identify parties having an interest in and the resources to support the requirement for upgrading our Commercial Gear Backup Power (CGBP) and associated control system at our electronic fish barrier located in Romeoville, Illinois. We are seeking to identify qualified Small Business concerns (including 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB, and Small Business Joint Ventures/Teaming Arrangements) and Other-Than-Small Business concerns capable of performing this requirement. The intention is to procure these services on a competitive basis.**********************BASED ON THE RESPONSES TO THIS SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE/MARKET RESEARCH, THIS REQUIREMENT MAY BE SET-ASIDE FOR SMALL BUSINESSES (IN FULL OR IN PART) OR PROCURED THROUGH FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION, and multiple awards MAY be made. All Small Business Set-Aside categories will be considered. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted or acknowledged, and no feedback or evaluations will be provided to companies regarding their submissions.**********************DISCLAIMER**********************THIS SOURCES SOUGHT IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP) TO BE SUBMITTED. IT DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A SOLICITATION AND SHALL NOT BE CONSTRUED AS A COMMITMENT BY THE GOVERNMENT. RESPONSES IN ANY FORM ARE NOT OFFERS AND THE GOVERNMENT IS UNDER NO OBLIGATION TO AWARD A CONTRACT AS A RESULT OF THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. NO FUNDS ARE AVAILABLE TO PAY FOR PREPARATION OF RESPONSES TO THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. ANY INFORMATION SUBMITTED BY RESPONDENTS TO THIS TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION IS STRICTLY VOLUNTARY. RESPPONSES WILL NOT BE RETURNED TO THE RESPONDER. NOT RESPONDING TO THIS NOTICE DOES NOT PRECLUDE PARTICIPATION IN ANY FUTURE REQUEST FOR QUOTE (RFQ) OR INVITATION FOR BID (IFB) OR RFP, IF ANY ISSUED. IF A SOLICITATION IS RELEASED, IT WILL BE SYNOPSIZED ON THE GOVERNMENT-WIDE POINT OF ENTRY (GPE). IT IS THE RESPONSIBILITY OF POTENTIAL OFFERORS TO MONITOR THE GPE FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMMATION PERTAINING TO THIS REQUIREMENT. The Government is not committed nor obligated to pay for the information provided, and no basis for claims against the Government shall arise as a result of a response to this Sources Sought.********************************************II. COMPREHENSIVE TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION and PROJECT SCOPE********************************************The Chicago Sanitary and Ship Canal (CSSC) Electric Dispersal Barrier facility requires a complex industrial electrical power generation, backup power, and automation and control system modernization project. This system is a critical component of the federal effort to prevent the movement of invasive aquatic species between the Great Lakes and Mississippi River basins. **********************Specifically, USACE needs to upgrade the backup generator and switchgear control systems at Permanent Barrier 1 (PB1) to correct unreliable operation caused by deficiencies in the original design, configuration, and wiring. The project requires replacing generator controllers, modernizing breaker controls and communications, and rebuilding the control software and operator interfaces to improve reliable operation on utility and backup power. Work will require testing, operator training, and a phased changeover to maintain continuous barrier operations. Work will be performed at an active, mission-critical facility requiring careful coordination with ongoing operations, planned equipment outages, and system changeovers to maintain operational readiness and minimize disruptions. A critical requirement is the integration of new equipment into an active industrial facility while protecting existing operations. The anticipated work may include engineering, design review, equipment upgrades and replacement, control system programming, integration, testing, and commissioning of interconnected electrical and industrial automation systems. ******************************************************************TECHNICAL CAPABILITIES:******************************************************************The project requires specialized expertise in: a) generator synchronization and load management, b) switchgear automation, c) protective relaying, d) programmable logic controllers (PLCs), e) human-machine interfaces (HMIs), industrial communications, and associated monitoring and data management systems.**********************Contractors must possess the technical capabilities necessary to work with the existing systems and integrate new equipment while maintaining compatibility and functionality. The existing facility incorporates Rockwell Automation ControlLogix PLCs, FactoryTalk View SE, FactoryTalk Transaction Manager, Microsoft SQL Server, Basler generator synchronization and control equipment, Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories (SEL) protective relays and RTAC equipment, and DEIF generator controllers. ATTACHMENT NOTICE: Interested parties must carefully review Attachment 1 (Equipment_SOW.xlsx ??? PB1 Equipment Modernization and SOW Matrix) attached to this notice in PIEE, the DoW Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment, which details the specific equipment removals, modifications, additions, hard-wired control conversions, I/O transitions, and as-built drawing updates (across four separate contractor drawing sets) required under our anticipated scope.**********************Contractors must demonstrate their capability of obtaining a specialized Master Systems Integrator (MSI) or Industrial Automation and Control Systems (IACS) engineering firm to perform any needed engineering, programming, integration, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of the complex interconnected industrial control systems.**********************Contractors must demonstrate their ability to obtain qualified personnel. Qualified personnel include Electrical Generating Systems Association (EGSA) certified technicians or personnel possessing equivalent documented qualifications to support generator-related engineering, design reviews, integration, testing, and commissioning. If proposing to use equivalent, provide what documentation your firm considers as equivalent for USACE consideration.**********************The contractor must possess the technical and organizational capabilities to execute phased modifications, coordinate authorized shutdowns and system changeovers, implement temporary control arrangements where necessary, perform pre-commissioning and acceptance testing, and develop contingency measures to minimize operational disruptions and maintain the safety, reliability, and continuity of existing barrier operations.**********************III. REQUESTED INFORMATION FROM INTERESTED PARTIES********************************************Interested firms are invited to submit a Capability Statement (not to exceed 10 pages) addressing the following four (4) sections after reviewing the technical capability narrative above and Attachment 1 (Equipment_SOW.xlsx):SECTION A: ADMINISTRATIVE AND BUSINESS SIZE********************************************1. Company Name, Address, Point of Contact, telephone number and email, CAGE Code, and Unique Entity Identifier (UEI).**********************2. Business Size under NAICS 238210 ($19.0M Size Standard) and all applicable socioeconomic designations.**********************3. If proposing as a Small Business, confirm your understanding of FAR 52.219-14 (Limitations on Subcontracting) and your ability to perform at least 25% of the cost of contract performance (excluding the cost of materials) with your own organization or similarly situated small business entities. **********************4. Should this requirement be solicited as Full and Open Competition, other-than-small-business offerors will be required to submit an acceptable Small Business Subcontracting Plan in accordance with RFO 19.1

This project will repair and construct an addition to an existing ~26,000 square feet of the maintenance part of the Equipment Concentration Site, Maintenance Building 56767, that is in a failing condition, and has not undergone any major infrastructure or system repairs, only limited maintenance and repair work has occurred. The project includes repair of HVAC and Electrical systems, remove non-structural interior walls to right-size rooms and create open flexible workspace, restore inadequate and non-code compliant bathrooms, repair light fixtures with code compliant units, failed flooring, code compliant fire alarm and suppression system, repair electrical conduit distribution throughout the facility. Access for individuals with disabilities will be provided to include a code compliant entrance ramp. The restored facility will meet minimum DOD Antiterrorism standards. This project contains options. The contract duration is estimated at 913 calendar days from Contract Notice to Proceed (NTP).This award is Subject to the Availability of Funds (SAF). The technical information contained in each Offeror s proposal will be reviewed, evaluated, and rated by the Government. Phase II Selected Offerors are requested to submit additional information described in Section 00 22 18 of the Solicitation, for review and evaluation by the Government. The selection process for Phase II will evaluate such factors as: Design Narrative, Management Plan, Schedule Narrative, and Price. The Standard Form (SF) 1442, resubmission of Evidence of Ability to Obtain Bonding and Proof of Financial Ability, and resubmission of Pre-Award Information will also be required. All evaluation factors, other than cost or price, are considered approximately equal to cost or price. CONSTRUCTION MAGNITUDE: The estimated construction magnitude of this construction project is anticipated to be between $10,000,000 and $25,000,000. description: Amendment 0001- Correct Set Aside error in the Instruction to Offerors Solicitation The Federal Bureau of Prisons (FBOP) is issuing solicitation 15BBNF27Q50100001 for the award of a firm-fixed-price construction contract for a project entitled Install Generator at the Federal Correctional Institution (FCI Bastrop), located in Bastrop, TX. FCI Bastrop is a federal correctional facility located at 1341 Highway 95 North, Bastrop, TX, 78602. description: PROJECT DESCRIPTION: The Office of Missile Air Defense Program (OMAD) is a Defense Access Road (DAR) program used by the Department of Defense (DoD) to fund the annual maintenance and improvements on certified gravel roads. FHWA works with the Military Surface Deployment and Distribution Command (SDDC) to support the Air Force Intercontinental Ballistic Missile Program (Minuteman). These Minuteman Missile Access Roads are located in 6 counties within North Dakota. SCOPE OF THE WORK: The work includes roadway reconditioning and adding four inches of aggregate surface course as well as the replacement of culverts. All proposed work is to stay on the existing roadway bench. The proposed typical section consists of reconditioning the existing gravel roadway per Section 303 and adding an additional 4-inches of Aggregate Surface Course with a maximum width of 24-feet. A 4% crown is proposed or as approved by the CO. The Contractor will need to taper down the proposed aggregate surface, per the typical section, at applicable locations.

title: Biomedical Research Application Evaluation and Support (BRAES)
description: This is a Request for Proposal (RFP) for Biomedical Research Application Evaluation and Support (BRAES) on behalf of the Congressionally Directed Medical Research Programs (CDMRP) within the Defense Health Agency (DHA) located in Frederick, MD at Fort Detrick. This requirement is a performance-based non-commercial, non-personal services support requirement and will be awarded as a Multiple Award Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quality (MA-IDIQ) contract. The CDMRP requires BRAES is for: 1) Funding opportunity announcement set-up within CDMRP electronic Biomedical Research Application Portal (eBRAP) (eBRAP task order awarded to a single vendor); 2) Oversight of electronic receipt and processing of intramural and extramural pre- and full research applications in eBRAP (eBRAP task order awarded to a single vendor); 3) Application compliance review in eBRAP (eBRAP task order awarded to a single vendor); and 4) Scientific merit peer review including operation of a secure Contractor-owned, Contractor-operated web-based electronic system which supports all activities and capabilities specific to peer review (i.e. Scientific Administration and Management/SAM) (SAM task orders awarded to multiple vendors). NOTE: The task orders associated with scientific peer review will be competed as fair opportunity between the successful BRAES Contract holders AFTER award of this MA IDIQ.

description: Amendment 3 (11/09/2026): ISO updates to Part II - Technical Areas & Requirements: TA1: Edits to the "Target" language for the Retrospective Data Access metric. Provides Attachment A2 for TA1 Solution Summary Requirements and Attachment A3 for TA2 Solution Summary Requirements. Amendment 1 (10/14/2026): Update due dates and/or times of all TAs SPECTRA will identify and act on autism trajectories, the evolving developmental paths individuals follow across the lifespan from the prenatal period through aging, spanning autism characteristics, co-occurring conditions, and functional outcomes together with the genetic, biological, behavioral, iatrogenic (medical influences), environmental factors and their nonlinear interactions. Rather than examining these factors in isolation, SPECTRA will examine how they combine and interact, including their nonlinear interactions, to produce autism and its co-occurring conditions over time. SPECTRA will also develop technologies that serve two purposes at once: extending reliable assessment beyond the clinic while improving everyday communication, function, and quality of life. The same tools people use to live more fully will also generate the data that drive measurement and personalized care.

title: ND OMAD 2025(1) Minuteman Missile Access Road
description: PROJECT DESCRIPTION: The Office of Missile Air Defense Program (OMAD) is a Defense Access Road (DAR) program used by the Department of Defense (DoD) to fund the annual maintenance and improvements on certified gravel roads. FHWA works with the Military Surface Deployment and Distribution Command (SDDC) to support the Air Force Intercontinental Ballistic Missile Program (Minuteman). These Minuteman Missile Access Roads are located in 6 counties within North Dakota. SCOPE OF THE WORK: The work includes roadway reconditioning and adding four inches of aggregate surface course as well as the replacement of culverts. All proposed work is to stay on the existing roadway bench. The proposed typical section consists of reconditioning the existing gravel roadway per Section 303 and adding an additional 4-inches of Aggregate Surface Course with a maximum width of 24-feet. A 4% crown is proposed or as approved by the CO. The Contractor will need to taper down the proposed aggregate surface, per the typical section, at applicable locations.

DeBakey VA Medical Center (MEDVAMC) in Houston, Texas, has a requirement titled "Replace OR Chillers� for project number 580-23-105, per issue for construction Drawings and Specifications. This acquisition will be solicited pursuant to the Veterans' First Public Law 109-461 as a 100% Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business Set-Aside (SDVOSB). At least 15 percent of the cost of the contract performance incurred for personnel shall be spent on the concern's employees or the employees of other eligible SDVOSB concerns. Please do not send questions to this notice as it is only a Pre-Solicitation Notice. Questions will be accepted only after the solicitation has been published. The magnitude of construction is between $1,000,000.00 and $2,000,000.00. North American Industrial Classification Standard (NAICS) code assigned to this construction project is 238220 with a small business size standard of $19 million in average annual receipts for the past three (3) years. Offerors shall be registered with SBA VetCert at Veteran Small Business Certification (sba.gov), in System for Award Management (SAM) database at www.sam.gov and have completed online Representations and Certifications prior to the solicitation due date. title: CO OMAD 300(71) Minuteman Missile Access
description: PROJECT DESCRIPTION: The Office of Missile Air Defense Program (OMAD) is a Defense Access Road (DAR) program used by the Department of Defense (DoD) to fund the annual maintenance and improvements on certified gravel roads. FHWA works with the Military Surface Deployment and Distribution Command (SDDC) to support the Air Force Intercontinental Ballistic Missile Program (Minuteman). These Minuteman Missile Access Roads are located in southwestern Wyoming, southeastern Nebraska, and northeastern Colorado. SCOPE OF THE WORK: The work includes roadway reconditioning and adding four inches of aggregate surface course as well as the replacement of culverts. All proposed work is to stay on the existing roadway bench. The proposed typical section consists of reconditioning the existing gravel roadway per Section 303 and adding an additional 4-inches of Aggregate Surface Course with a maximum width of 24-feet. A 4% crown is proposed or as approved by the CO. The Contractor will need to taper down the proposed aggregate surface, per the typical section, at applicable locations.

title: Announcement for Partnership Proposals: Atmospheric Exploration Observatory
description: NASA�s Science Mission Directorate (SMD), Earth Science Division (ESD), is inviting innovative partnership proposals for the Atmospheric Exploration Observatory to explore collaborative opportunities for hardware utilization. NASA is exploring partnerships with external organizations to enable more impactful exploitation of NASA resources and to advance the commercial remote sensing industry. This Announcement for Partnership Proposals (AFPP) invites proposals for innovative partnerships for atmospheric exploration. This AFPP envisions one or more partnerships to complete the former GeoCarb instrument, integrate the instrument with a spacecraft, launch, operate, and share its unique data with clear benefits to the selected partner(s). All meetings and forums will be virtual.

title: Kauniaisten keskusta-alueen vision laatiminen
description: Hankinnan kohteena on Kauniaisten keskusta-alueen vision laatiminen tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteenä olevan alustavantyöohjelman mukaisesti. Hankinta sisältää keskusta-alueen vision laatimisen, tarvittavan suunnittelu- ja asiantuntijatyön, vuorovaikutuksen suunnittelun ja toteuttamisen sekä alustavassa työohjelmassa määriteltyjen aineistojen tuottamisen. Työn tavoitteena on muodostaa Kauniaisten keskusta-alueen kehittämiselle noin vuoteen 2050 ulottuva yhteinen tavoitetila. Työnsisältö, työvaiheet ja tuotettavat aineistot on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön liitteenä olevassa alustavassa työohjelmassa. Hankintaan valitaan yksi (1) toimittaja, jonka kanssa tehdään hankintasopimus. Tarjousten valintaperusteena on kokonaistaloudellisesti edullisin tarjous. Kokonaistaloudellisen edullisuuden vertailuperusteina käytetään hintaa (30 %) ja laatua (70 %). Tarjousten pisteytys sekä laadun arviointiperusteet on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnössä. Työn arvioitu aloitusajankohta on tammikuu 2027. Sopimuskausi alkaa hankintasopimuksen allekirjoittamisesta ja on voimassa siihen saakka, kunnes toimeksianto on kokonaisuudessaan hyväksytysti toteutettu ja sopimukseen kuuluvat tehtävät onsuoritettu. Tavoitteena on saattaa keskusta-alueen visiotyö valtuustokäsittelyyn vuoden 2028 alussa. Tarjoajan tulee tarjota koko palvelukokonaisuus. Osatarjouksia ei hyväksytä. Hankinnan kokonaisarvon ei arvioida ylittävän hankintalain tarkoittamaa kansallista kynnysarvoa, vaan hankinta on pienhankintana toteutettava palveluhankinta. Hankinta-asiakirjat ovat saatavina täydellisinä ja veloituksetta Cloudian Tarjouspalvelu-toimittajaportaalissa. Mahdolliset hankintaan liittyvät tarkentavat kysymykset tulee lähettää Cloudian Tarjouspalvelu-toimittajaportaalista 15.11.2026 klo 23:59 mennessä. Esitetyistä kysymyksistä ja niihin annetuista vastauksista laaditaan yhteenveto, joka julkaistaan Tarjouspalvelu-toimittajaportaalissa 21.11.2026 mennessä. Kysymykset ja vastaukset esitetään suomen kielellä. Kukin tarjoaja on velvollinen tarkistamaan tarjouspyyntöaineiston ja siihen liittyvät lisätiedot Tarjouspalvelu-toimittajaportaalista ennen tarjouksen jättämistä. Muita lisätietoja ei katsota tilaajaa sitoviksi.

title: Germany – Electrical installation work of heating and other electrical building-equipment – Sanierung Baulich-Technische Infrastruktur: Mess- und Regelungstechnik
description: Die Generalverwaltung des Max Planck Institutes in München soll im laufenden Betrieb umfänglich saniert werden. Inhalt der gemäß Leistungsverzeichnis aufgeführten Leistungen ist die Erbringung von Leistungen der Mess- und Regelungstechnik. Dazu gehören der Aufbau von ASP's zur Regelung und Steuerung von Kälte und Heizungsanlagen. Außerdem ist die Einbindung in den Bestand zu realisieren. Da das Gebäude während der gesamten Arbeiten in Nutzung bleibt, sind alle Tätigkeiten daher mit höchster Sorgfalt sowie unter größtmöglichem Schutz des bestehenden Gebäudes und der vorhandenen Anlagen auszuführen. Um dies umzusetzen läuft das Bauvorhaben in mehreren Bauabschnitten ab. Achtung: Diese Ausschreibung beinhaltet Wartungsleistungen. Ausführungsfristen: Mit der Ausführung ist zu beginnen innerhalb von 12 Werktagen nach Zugang der Aufforderung durch den AG (§5Abs. 2 Satz 2 VOB/B). Die Aufforderung wird Ihnen vorauss. bis zum 01.02.2027 zugehen. Die Leistung ist zu vollenden (abnahmereif fertig zu stellen) innerhalb von 1182 Werktagen nach vorstehend angegebener Frist für den Ausführungsbeginn (5 Arbeitstagen/ Woche) sh. hierzu auch Anlage 1 der Besonderen Vertragsbedingungen VHB-214.. Hinweis betr. Bieterfragen aufgrund besonderer äußerer Ereignisse (z.B. Sars-COV-2 oder Ukraine Krieg): Bitte berücksichtigen Sie bei Ihrer Angebotserstellung etwaige mögliche bzw. erkennbare Beeinträchtigungen, z.B. in Bezug auf die Verfügbarkeit von Materialien und Produkten, Arbeitskräften, eine evtl. verzögerte Beibringung von geforderten Nachweisen, Auswirkungen auf etwaige Nachunternehmer etc. Fragen, die in diesem Zusammenhang auftreten, bitten wir rechtzeitig vor Angebotsfrist über das Nachrichtensystem der eVergabe zu stellen.

title: INDUSTRY DAY: LOW-VOLTAGE ELECTRICAL UPGRADES, VA-WIDE
description: INDUSTRY DAY: LOW-VOLTAGE ELECTRICAL UPGRADES OPPORTUNITIES - VA-WIDE The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Office of Acquisition, Logistics, and Construction (OALC), Office of Facilities Acquisition (OFA), Program Contracting Activity Center (PCAC), is hosting an industry day for vendors interested in providing low-voltage electrical services across multiple VA facilities nationwide. The goal is to share information with vendors about the program and for the government to gauge vendor interest, highlight industry concerns, and assist in the set-aside determination, if any, is appropriate for the program. This is an opportunity for industry to influence procurement decisions that will shape the course of the program. Due to the size, scope and complexity of this initiative, the VA is considering interest from all qualified and interested parties to the industry day event. The event will be a meet and greet, review of scope, deliverables, and review of potential solicitation and award methods. PROJECT DESCRIPTION / DESCRIPTION OF WORK / REQUIREMENT The VA has a requirement for an enterprise-wide program to replace designated existing electrical equipment rated 1,000 volts AC nominal or less, including automatic transfer switches (ATS), transformers, switchgear, and switchboards at more than 100 VA Medical Centers across the country during Fiscal Year 2027. This is a pre-scoped, specification-based, like-for-like equipment replacement program. The Contractor shall provide a completely installed and operational replacement while retaining existing distribution arrangements, feeders, raceways, and associated infrastructure. Work is limited to equipment replacement and necessary incidental installation modifications. EVENT The industry day will be held on December 7, 2026, in Cleveland, OH, from 1:00 PM ET to 4:00 PM ET, at the VA Building located at 6100 Oak Tree Blvd, Independence, OH 44131. Specific meeting room location to be sent to registered attendees. Due to limited accommodations, Registration is required to attend this event and will be limited to a total of 65 attendees and no more than 2 attendees from a firm. Registration will be first come first serve. Additional attendance will be accommodated through a virtual team�s link. Registration Instructions for Vendor Day: � Send an email stating your intention to attend the Vendor Day to the contacts listed below. � Provide Company Name, Main Point of Contact, and Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) � Provide the names and positions of no more than 2 within your company of those who plan to attend � Register no later than 5:00 PM ET on December 2, 2026. Send registration and any questions to Jennifer.Braaten@va.gov AND Bailey.Donato@va.gov ADMINISTRATIVE This notice is not a request for competitive offers. Any response to this notice will not be considered a bid or proposal. After completing its analyses, the Government will determine whether to limit competition among small business categories or proceed with full and open competition. This notice and event shall not be construed as a solicitation or as an obligation on the part of the Government. The Government will not provide reimbursement for any expenses incurred in participating in this notice and event. Currently, no solicitation exists; therefore, DO NOT REQUEST A COPY OF THE SOLICITATION. If a solicitation is released, it will be synopsized in Contract Opportunities at https://sam.gov/. It is the potential offeror's responsibility to monitor this site for the release of any solicitation or synopsis. title: INDUSTRY DAY: LOW-VOLTAGE ELECTRICAL UPGRADES, VA-WIDE
description: INDUSTRY DAY: LOW-VOLTAGE ELECTRICAL UPGRADES OPPORTUNITIES - VA-WIDE The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Office of Acquisition, Logistics, and Construction (OALC), Office of Facilities Acquisition (OFA), Program Contracting Activity Center (PCAC), is hosting an industry day for vendors interested in providing low-voltage electrical services across multiple VA facilities nationwide. The goal is to share information with vendors about the program and for the government to gauge vendor interest, highlight industry concerns, and assist in the set-aside determination, if any, is appropriate for the program. This is an opportunity for industry to influence procurement decisions that will shape the course of the program. Due to the size, scope and complexity of this initiative, the VA is considering interest from all qualified and interested parties to the industry day event. The event will be a meet and greet, review of scope, deliverables, and review of potential solicitation and award methods. PROJECT DESCRIPTION / DESCRIPTION OF WORK / REQUIREMENT The VA has a requirement for an enterprise-wide program to replace designated existing electrical equipment rated 1,000 volts AC nominal or less, including automatic transfer switches (ATS), transformers, switchgear, and switchboards at more than 100 VA Medical Centers across the country during Fiscal Year 2027. This is a pre-scoped, specification-based, like-for-like equipment replacement program. The Contractor shall provide a completely installed and operational replacement while retaining existing distribution arrangements, feeders, raceways, and associated infrastructure. Work is limited to equipment replacement and necessary incidental installation modifications. EVENT The industry day will be held on December 7, 2026, in Cleveland, OH, from 1:00 PM ET to 4:00 PM ET, at the VA Building located at 6100 Oak Tree Blvd, Independence, OH 44131. Specific meeting room location to be sent to registered attendees. Due to limited accommodations, Registration is required to attend this event and will be limited to a total of 65 attendees and no more than 2 attendees from a firm. Registration will be first come first serve. Additional attendance will be accommodated through a virtual team�s link. Registration Instructions for Vendor Day: � Send an email stating your intention to attend the Vendor Day to the contacts listed below. � Provide Company Name, Main Point of Contact, and Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) � Provide the names and positions of no more than 2 within your company of those who plan to attend � Register no later than 5:00 PM ET on December 2, 2026. Send registration and any questions to Jennifer.Braaten@va.gov AND Bailey.Donato@va.gov ADMINISTRATIVE This notice is not a request for competitive offers. Any response to this notice will not be considered a bid or proposal. After completing its analyses, the Government will determine whether to limit competition among small business categories or proceed with full and open competition. This notice and event shall not be construed as a solicitation or as an obligation on the part of the Government. The Government will not provide reimbursement for any expenses incurred in participating in this notice and event. Currently, no solicitation exists; therefore, DO NOT REQUEST A COPY OF THE SOLICITATION. If a solicitation is released, it will be synopsized in Contract Opportunities at https://sam.gov/. It is the potential offeror's responsibility to monitor this site for the release of any solicitation or synopsis. title: RWP - Extreme Loads Tire Force Machine (ELTFM)
description: To: AEDC Velocity Alliance Consortium and Industry Partners via SAM.gov Project Title: Extreme Loads Tire Force Machine (ELTFM) Contracting Organization: AFTC/PZ (Arnold) Applicable NAICS Code: 334519 � Other Measuring and Controlling Device Manufacturing (Physical Properties Testing Equipment) Applicable PSC Code: 6635 � Physical Properties Testing and Inspection Equipment Acquisition Authority: 10 U.S.C. � 4022 � Other Transaction Authority for Prototypes Offerors may recommend an alternate NAICS or PSC code for consideration. The 704th Test Group (704 TG) Aerospace Survivability and Safety Office (OL-AC) at Wright- Patterson AFB, Ohio, requires an advanced, state-of-the-art testing capability to replace its legacy Tire Force Machine (TFM). Currently, the legacy system cannot meet the high vertical and lateral load requirements of current tire test profiles. To bridge this critical testing gap, the Government is initiating the Extreme Loads Tire Force Machine (ELTFM) prototype project. The ELTFM is conceived as a unique, high-capacity dynamic test machine designed to bridge the operational gap between high-speed dynamometer force testing and static load presses. See request for white paper attached for details. NOTE: The requirement documents for this effort are marked Distribution D and/or Export Controlled. For access to these documents, please provide your company's CAGE to the POCs listed. Once CMMC Level 2 (Self) and JCP certification are confirmed, the documents will be sent via DoD SAFE.

description: INDUSTRY DAY: LOW-VOLTAGE ELECTRICAL UPGRADES OPPORTUNITIES - VA-WIDE The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Office of Acquisition, Logistics, and Construction (OALC), Office of Facilities Acquisition (OFA), Program Contracting Activity Center (PCAC), is hosting an industry day for vendors interested in providing low-voltage electrical services across multiple VA facilities nationwide. The goal is to share information with vendors about the program and for the government to gauge vendor interest, highlight industry concerns, and assist in the set-aside determination, if any, is appropriate for the program. This is an opportunity for industry to influence procurement decisions that will shape the course of the program. Due to the size, scope and complexity of this initiative, the VA is considering interest from all qualified and interested parties to the industry day event. The event will be a meet and greet, review of scope, deliverables, and review of potential solicitation and award methods. PROJECT DESCRIPTION / DESCRIPTION OF WORK / REQUIREMENT The VA has a requirement for an enterprise-wide program to replace designated existing electrical equipment rated 1,000 volts AC nominal or less, including automatic transfer switches (ATS), transformers, switchgear, and switchboards at more than 100 VA Medical Centers across the country during Fiscal Year 2027. This is a pre-scoped, specification-based, like-for-like equipment replacement program. The Contractor shall provide a completely installed and operational replacement while retaining existing distribution arrangements, feeders, raceways, and associated infrastructure. Work is limited to equipment replacement and necessary incidental installation modifications. EVENT The industry day will be held on December 7, 2026, in Cleveland, OH, from 1:00 PM ET to 4:00 PM ET, at the VA Building located at 6100 Oak Tree Blvd, Independence, OH 44131. Specific meeting room location to be sent to registered attendees. title: Netherlands – Grounds maintenance services – Extensief maaien in Ommen
description: Op basis van een dienstverleningsovereenkomst verzorgt ROVA in de gemeente Ommen het maaien van extensief gras in de openbare ruimte. Het doel van de opdracht is om alle bermen met extensief gras te onderhouden, waarmee het aanzicht, de verkeersveiligheid almede het behoud van de rol die het extensief gras vervult als functie voor de ecologische groenstructuur door te zorgen voor een geleidelijke overgang tussen cultuur- en natuurgroen. De jaarlijkse omvang van perceel 1 bestaat uit circa 16.000 are extensief maaien en maaien met afzuigen van bermen, taluds, wadi's en watergangen. Daarnaast circa 110 km extra maaien van bermstroken, 1 meter breed, en het bijmaaien rondom circa 27.900 obstakels. De jaarlijkse omvang van perceel 2 bestaat uit circa 10.000 are extensief maaien en maaien met afzuigen van bermen, taluds en overige groenstroken. Daarnaast circa 85 km extra maaien van bermstroken, 1 meter breed, en het bijmaaien rondom circa 17.800 obstakels.

title: Netherlands – Street-cleaning and sweeping services – Onkruidbestrijding in Ommen
description: Op basis van een dienstverleningsovereenkomst verzorgt ROVA in de gemeente Ommen de onkruidbestrijding op verhardingen in de openbare ruimte. Het doel van de opdracht is om door middel van frequente onkruidbestrijding de verhardingen in de gemeente Ommen zo te onderhouden, waarmee het aanzicht en de verkeersveiligheid worden behouden. De opdracht betreft het beeldgericht beheersen van onkruid op verhardingen binnen de gemeente Ommen overeenkomstig de Kwaliteitscatalogus Openbare Ruimte (KOR). De werkzaamheden omvatten het jaarrond beheersen van onkruid op circa 3650 are elementen- en ongebonden verhardingen en rondom circa 6.000 obstakels. De werkzaamheden worden uitgevoerd op basis van kwaliteitsniveaus A en B.

Den forventede omsætning er således ikke bindende for ordregiver. Tilsvarende gælder for mængder angivet i tilbudslisten som skal ses som repræsentative for forbrug ud fra projektplaner. Den maksimale omsætning på aftalen er kr. 63.916.541 kr. . I beregningen af den maksimale mængde og værdi er der særligt taget højde for prisudvikling, usikkerhed om behov, geopolitiske kriser, pandemier samt politiske beslutninger. Inspektionsfartøjet POUL LØWENØRN er ikke certificeret til at sejle uden for dansk farvand, hvorfor den tilbudte værft kapacitet skal kunne tilgås uden at forlade dansk farvand. Rammeaftalen kan anvendes til værftsopgaver fra den 8. juli 2027 og løber til og med den 7. juli 2031, hvorefter den ophører uden yderligere varsel. I perioden mellem underskrift og den 8. juli 2027 kan parterne gennemføre nødvendig planlægning og forberedelse af samarbejdet.

title: Poland – Refuse and waste related services – Usługi odbioru, transportu i zagospodarowania frakcji odpadów o kodzie 19 05 03
description: 1. Przedmiotem zamówienia są usługi sukcesywnego odbioru, transportu i zagospodarowania odpadów o kodzie 19 05 03 – kompost nieodpowiadający wymaganiom (nienadający się do wykorzystania), pochodzących z Instalacji Komunalnej w Suwałkach. 2. Ilość odpadów o kodzie 19 05 03 jaką Zamawiający przekaże do odbioru, transportu i zagospodarowania w okresie obowiązywania umowy wynosi około 8.000 Mg. Maksymalna ilość dzienna około 100 Mg. Średnia waga jednego załadunku wyniesie w okresie miesiąca minimum ok. 23 Mg przy załadunku naczep o objętości co najmniej 90 m3. Powyższe ilości mają charakter szacunkowy i służą Wykonawcy pomocniczo do przygotowania oferty oraz prawidłowego skalkulowania kosztów realizacji zamówienia. Zamawiający nie jest zobowiązany do realizacji zamówienia w pełnym szacunkowym wymiarze, a rzeczywista ilość odpadów przekazywanych do odbioru, transportu i zagospodarowania będzie wynikała z bieżących potrzeb Zamawiającego. Zamawiający gwarantuje jednak, że w okresie obowiązywania umowy przekaże Wykonawcy do odbioru, transportu i zagospodarowania co najmniej 4.000 Mg odpadów o kodzie 19 05 03. Wykonawcy nie będą przysługiwały roszczenia z tytułu niezrealizowania przez Zamawiającego zamówienia powyżej gwarantowanej minimalnej ilości 4.000 Mg. 3. Odpad o kodzie 19 05 03 stanowi regularnie wytwarzany materiał o wielkości do 20 mm powstały w procesie przesiewania na sicie mobilnym wyposażonym w bęben o perforacji do 20 mm frakcji odpadów stabilizatu o kodzie 19 05 99 powstałego po procesie biologicznego przetwarzania w instalacjach PGO w Suwałkach Sp. z o. o. frakcji podsitowej <80 mm wydzielonej ze zmieszanych (niesegregowanych) odpadów komunalnych i/lub kompostowania rozdrobnionych bioodpadów (odpady kuchenne i odpady zielone). Odbierane partie odpadów mogą różnić się co do wartości, a jakiekolwiek różnice nie będą stanowiły podstaw roszczeń Wykonawcy w stosunku do Zamawiającego. 4. Odpady objęte niniejszym zamówieniem należy przetransportować, a następnie zagospodarować w instalacjach, które posiadają decyzje zezwalające na przetwarzanie tych odpadów w procesie odzysku, w sposób zgodny z obowiązującymi przepisami prawa w tym zakresie oraz z wykorzystaniem minimum jednego procesu odzysku od R3 do R12, określonych w niewyczerpującym wykazie procesów odzysku stanowiącym załącznik nr 1 do ustawy z dnia 14 grudnia 2012 r. o odpadach (t.j. Dz. U. z 2023 r. poz. 1587, z późn. zm.). 5. Odbiór odpadów następować będzie transportem zorganizowanym przez Wykonawcę i na jego koszt, także w zakresie kosztów przewozu, ubezpieczenia na czas transportu i rozładunku. 6. Odpady o kodzie 19 05 03 magazynowane są luzem na utwardzonym placu i w takiej formie zostaną załadowane na podstawione przez Wykonawcę środki transportu.

title: Germany – Financial leasing services – Rahmenvereinbarung für das Dienstradleasing der Stadt Delmenhorst
description: Die Stadt Delmenhorst möchte eine Rahmenvereinbarung über das Leasing von Fahrrädern für seine ca. 1430 Mitarbeitenden abschließen. Die Stadt Delmenhorst bietet ihren Tarifbeschäftigten bereits seit dem 01.01.2023 die Möglichkeit ein Dienstfahrrad im Wege der Entgeltumwandlung zur dienstlichen sowie privaten Nutzung. Damit das Angebot des Dienstradleasing weiterhin bereitgestellt werden kann, soll im Rahmen einer Folgeausschreibung eine Anbieterin bzw. ein Anbieter (Kooperation aus Service-Dienstleistenden mit Fachhandelnden, Leasinggebenden und Versicherungsdienstleistenden) gefunden werden. Die Stadt Delmenhorst stellt dabei die Leasingnehmerin dar, welche den Beschäftigten und Beamten das Dienstrad zur Verfügung stellt. Eine Rahmenvereinbarung soll dabei den Leasinginhalt darstellen, die die Bereitstellung von Fahrrädern im Wege des Leasings (Teilamortisationsleasing) zum Zwecke der Überlassung an die Beschäftigten und Beamten zur dienstlichen und privaten Nutzung einschließlich Versicherungs-, Schulungs- und Serviceleistungen, insbesondere die Abwicklung der Bestell-, Rückgabe- und Schadenabwicklungsprozesse, Wartung und Reparatur, Störfallmanagement und Bereitstellung eines Online-Portals beinhalten. Die Rahmenvereinbarung schließt die Auftraggeberin mit der Auftragnehmerin bzw. dem Auftragnehmer. Die im Rahmen eines Angebots gemachten finanziellen Konditionen, insbesondere die Leasingrate inkl. Versicherung sowie (teils optionalem) Service- und Versicherungspaket, werden für die Laufzeit der Rahmenvereinbarung fest und verbindlich vereinbart. Die Auftraggeberin schließt auf Grundlage der Rahmenvereinbarung Einzelleasingverträge für die Beschäftigten und Beamten mit der Auftragnehmerin bzw. dem Auftragnehmer ab. Entsprechende Nutzungs- und Überlassungsverträge mit den Rechten und Pflichten der Beschäftigten sowie Beamten werden zwischen diesen und der Auftragnehmerin bzw. dem Auftragnehmer vereinbart. Die Nutzungs- und Überlassungsverträge regeln zudem die Entgeltumwandlung. Die Auftragnehmerin bzw. der Auftragnehmer koordiniert nach Maßgabe der Leistungsbeschreibung die Gesamtleistung und wickelt diese einheitlich ab.

title: Germany – Building construction work – Totalunternehmer / Totalübernehmer Arnoldschule, Arnoldstr. 31
description: Die Stadt Bochum (nachfolgend "Auftraggeber") steht als Schulträger vor der Herausforderung, dem stetig wachsenden Raumbedarf aufgrund der steigenden Schulanmeldungen im Bochumer Stadtgebiet zu entsprechen. In diesem Zusammenhang herrscht - neben dem Erfordernis an Sanierungs- und Erhaltungsmaßnahmen bereits bestehender Schulgebäude - ein erheblicher Bedarf an der Schaffung neuer Sport- und Lernräume. Dabei ist der Auftraggeber nach dem Schulgesetz verpflichtet, Schulentwicklungsplanung zu betreiben. Zur Erfüllung dieser ihr gesetzlich obliegenden Pflicht plant der Auftraggeber dem wachsenden Raumbedarf im Rahmen eines umfassenden Schulbau- und Schulmodernisierungsprogramms zu begegnen. Dieses beinhaltet erforderliche Neubau-, Umbau- und Sanierungsmaßnahmen für 27 schulische Einrichtungen. Das Programm umfasst dabei alle Schularten und bezieht sich auf Grund-, Förder- und weiterführende Schulen. Eingebettet in dieses Schulbauprogramm soll nun die Erweiterung und der Umbau der Arnoldschule, Arnoldstr. 31, 44793 Bochum erfolgen. Die bauliche Erweiterung sowie der Umbau der Arnoldschule soll durch einen Totalunternehmer / Totalübernehmer erfolgen. Die Arnoldschule liegt in einem dicht bebauten innerstädtischen Wohngebiet im Stadtteil Griesenbruch. Das Schulgrundstück umfasst ca. 7.643 m². Nördlich des Grundstücks liegt jenseits der Arnoldstraße eine öffentliche Grünanlage. Der Hauptzugang erfolgt von Norden über eine fußläufige Verbindung zwischen Adolfstraße und Heuverstraße. In der Praxis wird der südliche Eingang zum Innenhof über die Henriettenstraße genutzt. Die Feuerwehrzufahrt erfolgt westlich über die Heuverstraße auf den Schulhof. Die Schule setzt sich aus drei Baukörpern zusammen: dem Schulgebäude mit Untergeschoss, Erdgeschoss und einem Obergeschoss im nördlichen Grundstücksbereich (ca. 864 m²), einem südlichen Gebäude mit zwei Betreuungsräumen der OGS (ca. 153 m²) sowie der Sporthalle im Südwesten (ca. 720 m²). Die Schulhoffläche beträgt ca. 2.680 m². Die Bestandsräume reichen für den prognostizierten Bedarf an Unterrichts- und Ganztagsflächen nicht aus. Die geplante Maßnahme soll in fünf Schritten realisiert werden: Schritt 1: Umnutzung Computerraum zu einem Klassenraum - bereits erfolgt; Ein Computerraum, der nicht mehr benötigt wurde, wurde bereits zu einem Klassenraum umgenutzt. Schritt 2: Containeranlage als zusätzlicher Klassenraum - bereits erfolgt; Es wurde bereits ein Container nördlich der Turnhalle aufgestellt und bietet Platz für einen weiteren Klassenraum. Schritt 3: Neubau; Zunächst wird der bestehende Spielplatz zurückgebaut. Im Anschluss kann der Neubau in Form eines Gebäuderiegels entlang der Adolfstraße am Standort des alten Spielplatzes erfolgen. Um den Schülerinnen und Schülern einen alternativen Pausenbereich zur Verfügung zu stellen, soll ein Zugang über die Henriettenstraße zum benachbarten Bolzplatz hergestellt werden. Schritt 4: Abbau des Containers und Herstellung des Spielplatzes; Im nächsten Schritt wird der Container durch den TU/TÜ abgebaut und der endgültige Spielplatz nördlich der Sporthalle hergestellt. Schritt 5: Umbau; Die erforderlichen Umbaumaßnahmen im Bestandsgebäude können parallel zu Schritt 4 durchgeführt werden. Gegenstand der vorliegenden Ausschreibung ist die vollständige Erbringung sämtlicher Planungs-, Bau-, Ausstattungs- und Inbetriebnahmeleistungen sowie die Übernahme des gesamten Schnittstellenrisikos. Die vollständige funktionale Leistungsbeschreibung wird mit Aufforderung zur Angebotsabgabe zur Verfügung gestellt. Aus dieser werden die planerischen Schnittstellen zwischen den verschiedenen Disziplinen, Gewerken und Fachbereichen zu entnehmen sein. Mit dieser EU-weiten Bekanntmachung wird der Teilnahmewettbewerb eingeleitet. Weitere Informationen sind den auf der Vergabeplattform zur Verfügung gestellten Vergabeunterlagen zu entnehmen.

title: Freibad Schrobenhausen - Betriebsführungsleistungen
description: Die Stadt Schrobenhausen ist Eigentümerin des Freibads Schrobenhausen, Thaddäus-Siber-Straße 3, 86529 Schrobenhausen. Die Stadt Schrobenhausen beabsichtigt, im Rahmen dieses Vergabeverfahrens die Betriebsführung für das Bad für die Saison 2026 (15. Mai 2026 bis 15. September 2026) mit einmaliger Verlängerungsoption für die Saison 2027 (15. Mai 2027 bis 15. September 2027) an einen Auftragnehmer zu vergeben. Außerdem kann die Stadt optional Ein- und/oder Auswinterungsleistungen beauftragen. Die Aufteilung in eine fest beauftragte Saison (Saison 2026) eine Verlängerungsoption (Saison 2027) ergibt sich daraus, dass der Auftraggeber perspektivisch seinen eigenen Personalstamm vergrößern und das Bad ohne fremdvergebene Betriebsführungsleistungen betreiben möchte. Ob und wann dies möglich ist, ist derzeit nicht im Einzelnen vorhersehbar. Eigenes Personal der Stadt Schrobenhausen ist vorhanden. Diese sind an den öffentlichen Tarifvertrag TVöD gebunden und sollen in der Zeit von 15. Mai – 15. September 2026 (d. h. regulär 124 Betriebstage) dem Auftragnehmer überlassen werden (Personalgestellung). Es handelt sich voraussichtlich um: • 1 Schwimmmeister in Vollzeit • 2 Rettungsschwimmer in Vollzeit. Die Einsatzstunden sowie wie das Eigenpersonals der Stadt Schrobenhausen sind vom Auftragnehmer in den Freibadbetrieb zu integrieren (dies wären mit oben genanntem Personalbesatz 450 Stunden). Zwischen der Stadt Schrobenhausen und dem Auftragnehmer ist in diesem Zusammenhang ein Arbeitnehmerüberlassungsvertrag zu schließen. Außerdem muss der Auftragnehmer Dritte (Mitglieder der Wasserwacht, geringfügig Beschäftigte) in den Freibadbetrieb integrieren. Der Betrieb der Schwimmbadkasse und Reinigungsleistungen werden durch städt. Personal und Dienstleistern erbracht und sind nicht Gegenstand des Vergabeverfahrens. Der Kioskbetrieb ist ebenfalls nicht Gegenstand des Vergabeverfahrens.

title: Aviation & Missile Technology Consortium (AMTC) Other Transaction Agreement (OTA) Request for Enhanced Whitepapers (RWP): AMTC-27-01
description: This is not a notice for a solicitation. This is not a Request for Proposal or Request for Whitepapers. This Special Notice is to advise interested members of the Aviation and Missile Technology Consortium (AMTC), as well as other interested members within the U.S. technology base, that a Request for Enhanced Whitepapers (RWP) has been issued by Advanced Technology International (ATI) for the Aviation and Missile Technology Consortium (AMTC). The AMTC, comprised of the National Armaments Consortium (NAC) and the Vertical Lift Consortium (VLC), has partnered with the U.S. Army�s Combat Capabilities Development Command Aviation & Missile Center and the Army Contracting Command, Redstone Arsenal (ACC-RSA) to develop innovative aviation and missile technologies that rapidly and affordably enhance warfighter lethality, survivability, and combat effectiveness. Please note that any projects awarded in response to the RWP (solicitation) will include the following statement relative to the potential for follow-on production: "In accordance with 10.U.S.C. 4022(f), and upon a determination that the prototype project for this transaction has been successfully completed, this competitively awarded prototype OTA may result in the award of a follow-on production contract or transaction without the use of competitive procedures." The Government is seeking Enhanced Whitepapers under the AMTC RWP in accordance with the AMTC-27-01 Objective Requirements Document (ORD). Interested parties can be directed to https://www.amtcenterprise.org to obtain information regarding this Request for Enhanced Whitepapers. Interested parties are required to be members of the Aviation and Missile Technology Consortium (AMTC) in order to respond to the solicitation. Interested parties who are not members and interested in becoming members should contact amtc@ati.org. Only members of the AMTC can respond to the solicitation.

title: Paradores de Turismo de España, S.M.E., S.A.
description: Para acreditar la solvencia técnica el licitador deberá justificar mediante certificados, de buena ejecución, haber realizado y finalizado, al menos, dos trabajos en los cinco últimos años naturales completos y ejercicio corriente hasta la fecha de publicación de la licitación, del mismo tipo o naturaleza al que corresponde el objeto del presente contrato, en los que se especifiquen el objeto de los trabajos, importe, fecha de realización y beneficiarios públicos o privados de los mismos, lugar de ejecución de las obras y se precisará si se realizaron según las reglas por las que se rige la profesión y se llevaron normalmente a buen término, de un importe igual o superior a 77.000,00 euros, cada uno. Los trabajos efectuados se acreditarán mediante certificados expedidos o visados por el órgano competente, cuando el destinatario sea una entidad del sector público o, cuando el destinatario sea un sujeto privado, mediante un certificado expedido por éste o, a falta de este certificado, mediante una declaración responsable del licitador.

title: Alcaldía del Ayuntamiento de Llanes
description: Relación de las obras ejecutadas en el curso de los cinco últimos años, avalada por certificados de buena ejecución; estos certificados indicarán el importe, las fechas y el lugar de ejecución de las obras y se precisará si se realizaron según las reglas por las que se rige la profesión y se llevaron normalmente a buen término; en su caso, dichos certificados serán comunicados directamente al órgano de contratación por la autoridad competente. El importe anual acumulado de dichas obras en el año de mayor ejecución deberá ser igual o superior al 70 por ciento del valor estimado del contrato (78.090,65 euros). Ver aptdo. 14 del anexo I del PCAP

title: Alcaldía del Ayuntamiento de San Miguel de Salinas
description: a) Una relación de los principales servicios o trabajos realizados de igual o similar naturaleza que los que constituyen el objeto del contrato en el curso de, como máximo los cinco últimos años, cuyo importe anual acumulado en el año de mayor ejecución sea igual o superior a 42.115,99 € (70 % de 60.165,70) en la que se indique el importe, la fecha y el destinatario, público o privado de los mismos, los servicios o trabajos efectuados se acreditarán mediante certificados expedidos o visados por el órgano competente, cuando el destinatario sea una entidad del sector público; cuando el destinatario sea un sujeto privado, mediante un certificado expedido por este o, a falta de este certificado, mediante una declaración del empresario acompañado de los documentos obrantes en poder del mismo que acrediten la realización de la prestación.

title: Empresa de Transformación Agraria S.A.,S.M.E., M.P., (TRAGSA)
description: En caso de no estar clasificado: Declaración responsable firmada electrónicamente por el representante legal de la empresa licitante que indique que ha realizado trabajos similares (mismo CPV) a los del objeto del contrato, por un importe acumulado, durante los últimos cinco años disponibles, de al menos al indicado para cada lote, según se detalla en el apartado E.1 Requisitos que acreditar del PCAP. En caso de licitar a más de un lote, se deberá acreditar la suma de las cantidades exigidas en cada uno de ellos. Junto con esta Declaración se deberá incluir una relación de trabajos realizados en los que aparezca la descripción de los mismos (alcance), las fechas de comienzo y de fin de la ejecución de los mismos, el cliente para el que se realizaron y el importe sin IGIC de estos, los cuales estarán avalados por certificados de buena ejecución emitidos por el Organismo Contratante.
